verdict.rationale: The evidence only gives capability ceilings: 'up to 240 FPS', 'up to 60 FPS at 4K', and 'resolutions up to 4K'. Nothing documents adaptive quality or bitrate when the network degrades, and nothing documents user-settable resolution or frame rate. A community report of smooth play over 4G shows performance, not a documented adaptation mechanism or manual controls, so this streaming-quality axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
